QuestInfo.name: The Dark Lord's Orders
QuestInfo.0: The Dark Lord contacts you. He must have news about the stolen jewel.
QuestInfo.1: The Dark Lord wants proof that the thief really had the powers of disguise. You'll need help from the Cygnus Knights and Resistance to get this proof. \r\nSpeak to Neinheart in Ereve.
QuestInfo.2: The Dark Lord wants proof that the thief really had the powers of disguise. You'll need help from the Cygnus Knights and Resistance to get this proof. \r\nYou speak to Neinheart in Ereve.

0.0: #h0#, you said the Explorer that appeared in Henesys was actually a man disguised as a girl. Are you absolutely certain about this? \r\n#L0##bYes, one hundred and ten percent.#l\n#k
0.1: I see. Sigh. The Soul Stone's disappearance has caused a bit of ruckus within the Explorer ranks... \r\n#L0##bThat doesn't sound good.#l\n#k
0.2: It's not as bad as it would've been if the thief had indeed been an Explorer. You've stopped that from happening. You have my thanks. \r\n#L0##bIt was nothing.#l\n#k
0.3: All we need to do now is locate the real culprit and retrieve the Seal Stone. And for that, we need you. Are you up to the task?

yes.0: Maple World is made up of three organizations: the Explorers, the Cygnus Knights, and the Resistance. We might be able to get useful intel from the other two groups.
yes.1: Find #bNeinheart#k in #bEreve#k and #bClaudine#k in #bEdelstein#k. See if they have any insight on the Master of Disguise and the Seal Stone.

no.0: You are an Explorer. It is your duty to help...

1.0: Welcome to Ereve. How may I assist you?

yes.0: A Master of Disguise? Yes, I can tell you about that...

npc.0: First go to Ereve and find #bNeinheart#k. He may look young but he is a flawless Tactician.
